programme.title: Rescuing The Nile's Sunken Temple
programme.desc: At the end of the 1970s, one of the largest Pharaonic sites in Egypt risked being swallowed up by the sea. After losing her sister, Elaine found an unlikely companion in a chicken named Flapper. What started with one chook soon turned into something much bigger. Over the years, Elaine has taken in countless lost and unwanted chooks, giving them a home, teaching them tricks, and forming a unique bond with her feathered family.

They move to Paris together where Charlotte begins an invasive series of treatment. She becomes increasingly depressed while Paul becomes frustrated by his own powerlessness. Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

programme.title: True Grit

She enlists the help of Rooster Cogburn, a one-eyed, trigger-happy U.S. Marshall with an affinity for drinking and hardened Texas Ranger LaBoeuf to track down the fleeing Chaney. Directed by Ethan and Joel Coen, and stars Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon and Hailee Steinfeld.

programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Charlotte is in the midst of a love affair with Paul when she discovers she has lung cancer. They move to Paris together where Charlotte begins an invasive series of treatment. She becomes increasingly depressed while Paul becomes frustrated by his own powerlessness. Then he meets Charlotte's cousin Ninon, and things go awry. Directed by Xavier Giannoli and stars Laura Smet, Nicolas Duchauvelle and Marie Denarnaud.

programme.desc: Set in the artistic underground of 1930s China, this is the epic story of Mei Lanfang - the performer who overcame prejudice to become China's greatest opera star. Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

programme.title: Ride In The Whirlwind
programme.desc: Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver.

Inspired by his favourite play, Cyrano de Bergerac, Raymond hatches a plan to save his farm and his business through the art of theatre. Directed by Mélanie Auffret and stars Guillaume de Tonquédec and Léa Drucker.

The book recounting his experience is a bestseller and his television show breaks audience records. He is then approached by the mysterious Aurelie Diaz who will bring Jack Mimoun back to Val Verde to train him in search of the legendary sword of the pirate La Buse.

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

When the couple receives a letter from an old holiday friend, Maartje manages to convince her reluctant husband to get into their old car and go on a journey bickering all the way, but also stirring up old memories.

A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

His signature dish is his Tomato Collection, an eclectic mix of the world's finest tomatoes prepared in multiple ways. programme.title: Rescuing The Nile's Sunken Temple

It was thus 'moved' to an artificial island made to resemble the original - Philae. Thanks to comparative archeology - using images of monuments' remains from the same period - it is now possible to imagine how even heavily damaged buildings looked like at the time down to the most minute of details.

programme.title: Rescuing The Nile's Sunken Temple

The pair catch up over high tea on a steam train before overnighting in a glamping pod at Yorkshire Burrows with views of the Howardian and Hambleton Hills. The next day sees Robson and Chris go Fossil hunting at Saltwick Bay before they learn about traditional bee keeping using straw skeps.

programme.title: Robson Green's Weekend Escapes
programme.desc: Robson heads to the Cairngorms with presenter Gail Porter. The pair mountain bike through the beautiful countryside around Loch Malachie and take in the views. They sit patiently to get a glimpse of an osprey in the wild before checking into their glamping sight digs. Poetry, fresh air and landscapes dotted with Highland cattle make for a restful weekend.

programme.title: Ancient Greece By Train
programme.desc: The Ancient Greek culture that permeated this part of the world had a lasting effect. Alice sees the spectacular city of Ephasus that has been beautifully preserved; travelling to the next location she is saddened to see an important historic rock carving, from an empire before the Greeks, has been recently vandalised.

programme.title: 8 Out Of 10 Cats Does Countdown

programme.title: Mother Of Chooks
programme.desc: Elaine Janes has many names; Chook Lady, Chook Whisperer, Crazy Lady. But to those who know her story, she’s something more. After losing her sister, Elaine found an unlikely companion in a chicken named Flapper. What started with one chook soon turned into something much bigger. Over the years, Elaine has taken in countless lost and unwanted chooks, giving them a home, teaching them tricks, and forming a unique bond with her feathered family.

programme.title: Tour Auvergne-rhone-alpes 2026

programme.title: In The Land Of Brothers
programme.desc: Under the shadow of the US invasion, an extended Afghan refugee family begins their new lives in Iran unaware of the ultimate price expected of them as outliers in this (un)welcoming environment: Mohammad, a young teenager and promising student; Leila, a woman isolated by geography, and Qasem who bears the weight of his family's sacrifice.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Mattie Ross is determined to avenge her father's blood by capturing Tom Chaney, the man who shot and killed him for two pieces of gold. She enlists the help of Rooster Cogburn, a one-eyed, trigger-happy U.S. Marshall with an affinity for drinking and hardened Texas Ranger LaBoeuf to track down the fleeing Chaney. Directed by Ethan and Joel Coen, and stars Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon and Hailee Steinfeld.

programme.title: Eager Bodies
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Charlotte is in the midst of a love affair with Paul when she discovers she has lung cancer. They move to Paris together where Charlotte begins an invasive series of treatment. She becomes increasingly depressed while Paul becomes frustrated by his own powerlessness. Then he meets Charlotte's cousin Ninon, and things go awry. Directed by Xavier Giannoli and stars Laura Smet, Nicolas Duchauvelle and Marie Denarnaud.

Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

programme.title: Ride In The Whirlwind

Inspired by his favourite play, Cyrano de Bergerac, Raymond hatches a plan to save his farm and his business through the art of theatre. Directed by Mélanie Auffret and stars Guillaume de Tonquédec and Léa Drucker.

The book recounting his experience is a bestseller and his television show breaks audience records. He is then approached by the mysterious Aurelie Diaz who will bring Jack Mimoun back to Val Verde to train him in search of the legendary sword of the pirate La Buse.

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

When the couple receives a letter from an old holiday friend, Maartje manages to convince her reluctant husband to get into their old car and go on a journey bickering all the way, but also stirring up old memories.

A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.desc: Rick explores the beating heart of the post-war British modern art movement in the seaside town of St Ives, the home for leading artists such as Barbara Hepworth and Terry Frost. Chef de Cuisine, Kirk Westaway, has been in charge of Jaan for just over two years and recently received his first Michelin Star. His signature dish is his Tomato Collection, an eclectic mix of the world's finest tomatoes prepared in multiple ways. Adam is shown just how much effort it takes to achieve such perfection, and then samples the dish and the rest of Jaan's menu with unparalleled views over the city and harbour areas.

programme.desc: At the end of the 1970s, one of the largest Pharaonic sites in Egypt risked being swallowed up by the sea. It was thus 'moved' to an artificial island made to resemble the original - Philae. Thanks to comparative archeology - using images of monuments' remains from the same period - it is now possible to imagine how even heavily damaged buildings looked like at the time down to the most minute of details.

Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

After losing her sister, Elaine found an unlikely companion in a chicken named Flapper. What started with one chook soon turned into something much bigger. Over the years, Elaine has taken in countless lost and unwanted chooks, giving them a home, teaching them tricks, and forming a unique bond with her feathered family.

programme.title: Rescuing The Nile's Sunken Temple

Then he meets Charlotte's cousin Ninon, and things go awry. Directed by Xavier Giannoli and stars Laura Smet, Nicolas Duchauvelle and Marie Denarnaud.

programme.title: Forever Enthralled

Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

programme.title: Ride In The Whirlwind

Inspired by his favourite play, Cyrano de Bergerac, Raymond hatches a plan to save his farm and his business through the art of theatre. Directed by Mélanie Auffret and stars Guillaume de Tonquédec and Léa Drucker.

programme.title: True Grit

The book recounting his experience is a bestseller and his television show breaks audience records. He is then approached by the mysterious Aurelie Diaz who will bring Jack Mimoun back to Val Verde to train him in search of the legendary sword of the pirate La Buse.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: An assassin accepts a dangerous mission to kill a political leader in eighth century China.

programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Memory Lane

When the couple receives a letter from an old holiday friend, Maartje manages to convince her reluctant husband to get into their old car and go on a journey bickering all the way, but also stirring up old memories.

A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. The next day sees Robson and Chris go Fossil hunting at Saltwick Bay before they learn about traditional bee keeping using straw skeps.

programme.title: Robson Green's Weekend Escapes
programme.desc: Robson heads to the Cairngorms with presenter Gail Porter. The pair mountain bike through the beautiful countryside around Loch Malachie and take in the views. They sit patiently to get a glimpse of an osprey in the wild before checking into their glamping sight digs. Poetry, fresh air and landscapes dotted with Highland cattle make for a restful weekend.

programme.desc: The Ancient Greek culture that permeated this part of the world had a lasting effect. Alice sees the spectacular city of Ephasus that has been beautifully preserved; travelling to the next location she is saddened to see an important historic rock carving, from an empire before the Greeks, has been recently vandalised.

programme.title: 8 Out Of 10 Cats Does Countdown

programme.title: Mother Of Chooks
programme.desc: Elaine Janes has many names; Chook Lady, Chook Whisperer, Crazy Lady. But to those who know her story, she’s something more. After losing her sister, Elaine found an unlikely companion in a chicken named Flapper. What started with one chook soon turned into something much bigger. Over the years, Elaine has taken in countless lost and unwanted chooks, giving them a home, teaching them tricks, and forming a unique bond with her feathered family.

programme.desc: Under the shadow of the US invasion, an extended Afghan refugee family begins their new lives in Iran unaware of the ultimate price expected of them as outliers in this (un)welcoming environment: Mohammad, a young teenager and promising student; Leila, a woman isolated by geography, and Qasem who bears the weight of his family's sacrifice.

programme.title: True Grit

She enlists the help of Rooster Cogburn, a one-eyed, trigger-happy U.S. Marshall with an affinity for drinking and hardened Texas Ranger LaBoeuf to track down the fleeing Chaney. Directed by Ethan and Joel Coen, and stars Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon and Hailee Steinfeld.

programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Charlotte is in the midst of a love affair with Paul when she discovers she has lung cancer. They move to Paris together where Charlotte begins an invasive series of treatment. She becomes increasingly depressed while Paul becomes frustrated by his own powerlessness. Then he meets Charlotte's cousin Ninon, and things go awry. Directed by Xavier Giannoli and stars Laura Smet, Nicolas Duchauvelle and Marie Denarnaud.

Born in Beijing in 1894, Mei grew up in a period where an opera career was only slightly more respectable than prostitution. Nominated for the Golden Bear at the 2009 Berlin International Film Festival. Directed by Chen Kaige and stars Leon Lai, Zhang Ziyi and Sun Hong-Lei.

Directed by Mélanie Auffret and stars Guillaume de Tonquédec and Léa Drucker.

The book recounting his experience is a bestseller and his television show breaks audience records. He is then approached by the mysterious Aurelie Diaz who will bring Jack Mimoun back to Val Verde to train him in search of the legendary sword of the pirate La Buse.

When the couple receives a letter from an old holiday friend, Maartje manages to convince her reluctant husband to get into their old car and go on a journey bickering all the way, but also stirring up old memories.

A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

His signature dish is his Tomato Collection, an eclectic mix of the world's finest tomatoes prepared in multiple ways. Adam is shown just how much effort it takes to achieve such perfection, and then samples the dish and the rest of Jaan's menu with unparalleled views over the city and harbour areas.

It was thus 'moved' to an artificial island made to resemble the original - Philae. Thanks to comparative archeology - using images of monuments' remains from the same period - it is now possible to imagine how even heavily damaged buildings looked like at the time down to the most minute of details.
